on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			# on_startup has no country scope: enter USA explicitly.
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = USA
					USA = { IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }
				}
				USA = { mdcw_cw_initialize = yes }
			}
		}
	}

	on_monthly = {
		effect = {
			# Savegame bootstrap: a 1970 game started before this system existed.
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
					IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
				}
				mdcw_cw_initialize = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
				# on_monthly pulses per country; the global tick runs once.
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_monthly_done } }
					set_global_flag = { flag = mdcw_cw_monthly_done days = 27 value = 1 }
					mdcw_cw_global_monthly = yes
				}
				mdcw_cw_country_monthly = yes
			}
		}
	}

	# ROOT = attacker, FROM = defender
	on_war_relation_added = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
				mdcw_cw_on_war_relation = yes
			}
		}
	}

	# ROOT = sender, FROM = receiver
	on_send_volunteers = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
				mdcw_cw_on_volunteers = yes
			}
		}
	}

	# ROOT = country with the new government, FROM = coup sponsor
	on_coup_succeeded = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
				mdcw_cw_on_coup = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
